activity.notes: Sigismund of Luxembourg was crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome on 31 May 1433 and remained emperor until his death on 9 December 1437. ATLAS records only the imperial office interval and reuses the existing Holy Roman Empire polity, keeping his longer kingships in Hungary, Germany and Bohemia outside this representative Activity.
